title: AlloyDB: Edition Field Deprecated, Use ExpressConfig
summary: The `edition` field on AlloyDB `Backup` and `Cluster` resources is now deprecated, with explicit guidance to use `ExpressConfig` instead. A new `expressConfig` property has been added to `Backup` as an output-only field.
details: The `edition` property on both `Backup` and `Cluster` schemas, including all its enum values, is now formally deprecated. Its descriptions have been updated to clearly state: 'Deprecated: Use `ExpressConfig` instead.' This indicates a shift in how AlloyDB cluster editions are managed and configured. Additionally, a new `expressConfig` property has been introduced to the `Backup` schema. This property is `readOnly` and `output only`, meaning you cannot set it when creating or updating a backup; it reflects the `ExpressConfig` of the cluster from which the backup was created. Developers should update their code to stop using the deprecated `edition` field and rely on `ExpressConfig` for edition-related information, especially when interacting with backups.
